title: The Scales of Deeds and the Pride of Iblees

paragraphs.text: Allah destroyed many cities at night or at noon. Then they said they were wrongdoers. Allah will question the people and the messengers. Deeds will be weighed on that Day. Those with heavy scales will succeed. Allah gave you a place and a living on earth. But few of you are grateful.

The angels bowed to Adam, except Iblees. He said he was better, made from fire. Adam was made from clay. Allah sent him out of Paradise for his pride. Satan asked for time until the Day of Resurrection. He promised to sit on the straight path. He would come at people from every side. Allah will fill Hell with him and his followers.
Adam and his wife lived in Paradise. They were told not to go near one tree. But Satan whispered to them. He said the tree would make them angels or immortal.
